caption: Cape Lefkatas, Lefkada
composition: Lighthouse on the southern cliff tip · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: A path along Cape Lefkatas leads to a small white lighthouse on the cliff tip, with the sea on both sides. Cloud cover is about 11 percent, about 19.5°C. The sun is low in the east. The cape is unlit.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Cape Lefkatas lighthouse on Lefkada at sunrise

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold — scenario-light inconsistency: the master places the warm dawn glow on the right (west) horizon while the camera faces south toward the lighthouse tip and the note's solar azimuth about 92 degrees (east) puts the 07:40 sunrise to the left; the bright side of the sky is on the wrong side. Left as Candidate; needs a re-render with the dawn glow on the eastern (left) horizon consistent with the recorded solar geometry, no approval.

Approval withdrawn 2026-09-25 (Cosmo QC): the weather metadata was a shared/batch Open-Meteo retrieval (retrieval timestamp None identical across 3 scenes), failing Gate 2 under the confirmed standing policy — one HTTP fetch per scene, one recorded retrieval timestamp per scene; identical-to-the-second timestamps across scenes = shared retrieval. Rework: fetch Open-Meteo fresh per scene (own HTTP request, own recorded timestamp), scenario hour inside the model-valid hour; update the approvals note with the new retrieval evidence; re-push masters only if on-image text must change. Scene stays Candidate until Cosmo QC re-audits.

approval_basis: Gate 1: 16:9 follows the dirt cliff path to the small white cylindrical lighthouse with its lantern on the narrow rocky tip, white cliffs falling to deep water on both sides, no village in frame — all three geometry anchors; 4:5 shows the same lighthouse from a path-level angle with the sun disk low over the sea, consistent with 07:40 just after sunrise; plausible tourist viewpoints, clean, no artifacts. Gate 2: exact 1920x1080 / 864x1080 (sweep-verified); on-image strings verified: 'Cape Lefkatas, Lefkada', 'Scenario: 24 September 2026 · 07:40 Europe/Athens', 'AI-generated artistic interpretation · Not a photograph.', and the exact 'Jason D's Vision' signature on the bottom gradient; 07:40 inside model-valid hour 07:00–07:59 from per-scene unique Open-Meteo retrieval 2026-09-25T23:44:01Z (cross-checked against the authoritative repo note). Gate 3: text-prompt-only, no photographic inputs. Gate 4: no people, logos, or property of note — documented only. Gate 5: no open blockers.
